name: LiveAgent
one_liner: LiveAgent offers a REST‑style API that uses an API key for authentication and also provides an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for AI integrations.
auth_notes: Your API key has to be set in header of your requests:
access_notes: While logged in as an admin navigate to Configuration> System> API which loads the API v3 section where you find existing API keys or add a new one.

gate.process: Generate an API key in the admin panel under Configuration > System > API

evidence.snippet: API key is an identity of your LiveAgent (like your username and password) which you can use to build your own custom integration solutions.
evidence.subject: own-domain

evidence.snippet: While logged in as an admin navigate to Configuration> System> API which loads the API v3 section where you find existing API keys or add a new one.
evidence.subject: own-domain

evidence.snippet: You can find whole LiveAgent API documentation within your LiveAgent account: https://YOURDOMAIN.ladesk.com/docs/api/v3/#/
evidence.subject: own-domain

evidence.snippet: LiveAgent exposes a built-in MCP server (Model Context Protocol) that lets you connect external AI tools — such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, claude.ai, FlowHunt, or any other MCP-compatible client — directly to your LiveAgent account.
evidence.subject: own-domain
